content:
This update is focused on the new replay update and some small changes, see the details below.
And also, we are getting feedback/suggestions with the new replay update! Please don’t forget to join our Discord Server!
Changes Replay v3.0 Update This update will bring a complete overhaul to the current replay system, there are a lot of new features, bug fixes, QOL and more. Not to mention a complete tutorial to get you acquainted! Summary of all the replay changes: New Replay UI & Controls Replay Tutorial 1st Person POV Player health, hunger, breath, inventory & more stats Visualize pathing Splits viewer, navigation & alignment Piglin trades stat screen X-ray spawners/chests/goldblocks Pie chart recording Player in container recording Looted/Unlooted toggle for chests New Timeline Icons (By ollie) And more! Fixed an issue where ocean seed types sometimes get both shipwreck and buried treasure at spawn. Now, all strongholds will generate the same rooms/layout and still have the same amount of eyes too. Still, these will be affected by other generations such as cavern, dungeon, mineshaft, etc. We are looking into a way to fix this in the future. Added more splash texts. Bug Reports Please join our Discord Server to report any issues!
title: Mod Update - v6.0.0 Changelogs

content:
This is the first public changelogs in this blog! We are so glad with it 😊
Anyways, this update isn’t big update. but also, this is preparation for the Replay v3.0 Update. Focused on server storage for replays especially.
Changes Replay storage update As we’ve mentioned in the last maintenance announcement, We’ve changed a lot of backend stuffs for the replay storage, Due to this change, every past match replays are deleted from the server. However, you can still access on Weekly Race replays. Replay expiration time has been extended from 3 days to 7 days. Ranked mode match replays in the Top 50 record leaderboard of each season will now be stored as no expiration time. You can no longer download or watch more than 5 replays per minute Updated tab selections in ranked settings screen. Added more splash texts. Bug Reports Please join our Discord Server to report any issues!
